preconditions.description: Attacker must have some token balance to trigger overflow/underflow
Contract must not be deprecated (deprecated == false)
Contract must not be paused (paused == false)
Attacker must not be blacklisted (isBlackListed[attacker] == false)

exploit_hint: The contract uses SafeMath in most places but has unprotected arithmetic in the issue() and redeem() functions. As the owner, call issue() with a very large amount to cause integer overflow in the require() statements, bypassing the checks and minting tokens. Alternatively, manipulate transfer amounts to cause underflow in balances. The key is to trigger arithmetic overflow/underflow in unprotected operations.
